fake_news_detection.description: Fake news detection: comparative study of five NLP models (TF-IDF, DistilBERT, BERT — frozen vs fine-tuned). Best result: 98.63% accuracy with fine-tuned DistilBERT on 8,101 test articles.

SentinelML-SIEM-ML-detection-clean-and-m.description: Detecting network threats by combining Wazuh, Suricata, and machine learning in a fully virtualized, reproducible security lab.

SpringShopAnalytics.description: This Spring Boot backend connects to a MySQL database, providing RESTful APIs to manage shop data (customers, employees, orders, products) and uses SQL views for reporting. It demonstrates how Spring Boot integrates with a relational database via JDBC/JPA to expose data through HTTP endpoints.

Waschsalon.description: A Spring Boot application for managing washing machine reservations in a student environment. The system allows students to view available machines and time slots, create and manage reservations, and ensures that double bookings are prevented.
